interpretationGuards: Passing a geometry context establishes only bounded trained-corpus factorization for the stronger pooled objective.

Failure of APPEND_CONTEXT does not falsify CONDITION_FEATURES; they ask additive correction versus coefficient conditioning.
Semantic names such as win/draw character remain gauge labels.
